messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
With what minimum notice must the appointed verifier communicate to IGEA the planning of the checks on the devices?

response.text: Con quale preavviso minimo il verificatore incaricato deve comunicare a IGEA la pianificazione delle verifiche sui dispositivi?
